observed_gap.source_observation: The retained state-history gate recomputes test ordering/coverage and checks typed discriminator receipt shape, but it still accepts admissible=true, executed=true and a nonempty execution_receipt_id from the transported row. Current tests construct those values in the test helper. Therefore coherent row-carried receipt rewriting can satisfy shape/coverage without proving trusted deterministic producer execution.
observed_gap.counterhypothesis: Coverage recomputation alone is sufficient because the synthetic event outcome is deterministic.
observed_gap.counterhypothesis_rejected_because: Coverage recomputation proves only what the named test would separate under the supplied world/state. It does not prove that an authority-selected producer/policy admitted and executed the discriminator, nor that the execution_receipt_id was derived from that producer invocation rather than invented by the row.

authority_resolution: producer identity MUST be resolved from a repository authority manifest, never from the candidate row
authority MUST bind producer repo_path, exact source_sha256, producer schema/version and git/source lineage
authority MUST bind the allowed bounded case_id and deterministic discriminator policy identity/version
authority MUST retain canonical_truth_allowed=false, direct_effect_authority=false, training_eligible=false and zero-credit fences
input_binding: world identity and exact formal-world digest MUST come from the already authority-reconstructed generation path
pre-state digest MUST bind the exact state used for discriminator ordering/coverage
event identity MUST bind world_id + event semantic digest + test_id + observed synthetic outcome
formal discriminator spec digest MUST bind allowed outcomes and ordering-relevant test policy
candidate-carried producer path/hash/policy/admissibility/executed flags MUST have zero authority
deterministic_derivation: admissibility MUST be derived from the pinned policy and bound formal discriminator spec
u_test_order or its retained semantic equivalent MUST be recomputed by the trusted producer from the bound world/pre-state/test
separated_live_pairs and separates_all_live_pairs MUST be producer-derived and exact-match checked
executed=true MUST mean the deterministic synthetic producer invocation completed and returned the bound result; it MUST NOT be accepted as a row boolean
execution_receipt_id MUST be deterministically derived from producer identity + policy digest + world/pre-state/world-scoped-event/test digests + producer result digest
the row-carried discriminator receipt MUST exactly equal the recomputed producer receipt or fail closed
synthetic_scope: producer execution is SYNTHETIC_PROOF_ONLY and noncanonical
producer execution MUST NOT imply external-world observation
PASS mints zero canonical truth, real-effect, provider, runtime, J-Space, HCU, EntityOS or training credit

artifact_reclassification_delta.successor: same retained state-history lane with repository-authority-resolved deterministic discriminator producer proof
artifact_reclassification_delta.revision_reason: Pair coverage is mechanically recomputed, but admission/execution identity remains row-carried.
The helper itself constructs admissible=true, executed=true and execution_receipt_id; existing tests prove shape/outcome/coverage rejection but not trusted producer origin.
Ordering of generation->epistemic->state-history is correct, but the composition delegates to a state-history discriminator receipt path that still lacks producer authenticity.
Supervisor 8.78 conditional nuisance leakage remains dispositive; this A02 contract does not change that status.
Checkpoint-selection counterexamples remain useful but are orthogonal to A02 proof authenticity.

training_generation_decision.reason: Supervisor 8.78 explicitly requires A02 producer authenticity closure before new positive rows. Existing hard-negative families already cover the conceptual exploit; the highest-information nonduplicate delta is the exact producer-auth contract and mutation acceptance surface.

next_exact_action: Implement the authority-pinned deterministic discriminator producer and exact-match producer-auth gate in the single retained Hyperposition state-history lane; add T2_SHPG_A02_FAKE_EXECUTED and T2_SHPG_A02_COHERENT_RECEIPT_REWRITE plus source/policy/prestate/world-scope mutations; then obtain exact-current deterministic execution evidence before generating any positive pilot rows.
